profile_text.body:
Celestica Inc is a public company headquartered in Toronto, Ontario, and trades under the ticker CLS. On its own website, the company describes itself as a technology leader with expertise in design, engineering, and manufacturing, and says it works across high-growth markets. It states that it engineers, designs, and manufactures what it calls the backbone of AI and cloud technology, and that it enables critical data center infrastructure for AI, cloud, and hybrid cloud. The company also cites supply chain and platform solutions among its capabilities and describes a global network supporting its customers.

The company's stated position in AI is as an infrastructure and manufacturing partner rather than a developer of AI models or applications. Its site frames its role as fueling innovation across the markets it serves and helping customers achieve a competitive advantage.

Beyond the company profile, no litigation, no tracked AI products, and no MCP servers are recorded for Celestica. Its registration with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission is on file under CIK 0001030894.
